text: Started: CLI/Wetty terminal card. Existing CLI (scripts/cosmo.mjs) already covers board ops from shell. Reading terminal refusal history and researching Wetty (auth, default bind, deps) before recommending.

Done: report at .agents/research/browser_terminal_2026-08-02.md. Verdict: existing CLI already covers 'ops from a shell'; a hosted PTY terminal stays refused (Wetty defaults to 0.0.0.0 bind and no Origin check on its socket, verified from source, so run-as-proposed is the same hole relocated). But Wetty's real SSH/PAM login is a genuine difference from a raw PTY, so a user-run Wetty (--host 127.0.0.1) dropped into the board's existing link/app live-embed iframe is safe and needs zero new board code. Shipped one text-only hunk in patch.json pointing the dead-end Terminal switch panel at that route; anchor verified unique. report-only, no board/content touched.
